article.title: Sudan: External Involvement Fuelling Sudan War, New Report Finds
article.summary: [UN News] Foreign recruitment and external support networks are fuelling the brutal conflict in Sudan, strengthening the military capabilities of the warring parties and enabling increasingly sophisticated military operations with devastating consequences for civilians, independent UN human rights investigators said on Thursday, calling for action now to protect the population.

article.title: Sudan: Red Cross Helps 38,500 Families Reconnect As Sudan's Missing-Person Crisis Deepens
article.summary: [Dabanga] Amsterdam / Khartoum -- More than 11,000 people are now registered as missing in Sudan, a 40% increase in the past year, as the war fuels displacement, arrests, and disappearances, according to the International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC). The ICRC has helped 38,512 families reconnect or maintain contact with relatives, while clarifying the fate and whereabouts of 613 missing people in the first half of 2026, its spokesperson in Sudan, Farid Al Humaid, told Radio Dabanga.

Sudan: 10 Dead As WHO Flags Sudan's West Kordofan 'Latest Cholera Outbreak Hotspot'
article.summary: [Dabanga] El Fula, West Kordofan -- At least 10 people have died and more than 40 have been infected with cholera in Sudan's West Kordofan, according to the Kordofan Human Rights Observatory. The cases were recorded over Sunday and Monday in El Idai locality, as the World Health Organization (WHO) reports more than 2,600 cholera cases across several Sudanese states up to early August. It describes Kordofan as "the latest outbreak hotspot".
